title: Curiosity Universe verified on web and Android exports
summary: 21 discoveries, AI experiment, persistent journal and contextual Tutor handoff pass focused checks. Live AI and physical-device validation remain outstanding.

changes.detail: Interactive parameter/loss experiment, source-linked catalog, conceptual flows, 10 exploration modes, 21 retrieval questions, bookmarks, named collections, related concept map and due reviews.

Dashboard and More navigation expose Curiosity Universe. Tutor sessions preserve discovery ID, source context, journey stages and component explanations. Existing auth, cost controls, persistence and backups are reused.
Strict TypeScript indexing, backup recovery route, render-time clock handling and collection names matching inherited object keys. Corrupt journals are preserved and cannot be silently overwritten.

validation.name: Typecheck and focused lint
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck and ESLint on curiosity features, route, navigation and Tutor changes passed.

validation.name: Focused automated tests
validation.detail: 11 curiosity/change-history tests and 17 Tutor workspace/intelligence/budget regression tests passed; includes backup round-trip and bounded discovery context.

validation.name: Browser interactions
validation.detail: Disposable Edge tests passed in light and dark themes: mode selection, component nodes, weight prediction, incorrect/correct answers, bookmarking, collection creation, full reload persistence, map links, 390px overflow and contextual Tutor handoff. Auth mocked; no live AI response or cloud writes.

validation.name: Builds
validation.detail: Web export and Android JavaScript and Hermes bytecode exports passed. Initial sandbox denied Hermes execution; permitted retry passed. No APK installation or release deployment.

validation.name: Remaining validation and scope
validation.detail: No physical Android performance, screen-reader, expert editorial or live authenticated model-response test. Bundled catalog is English. AI language options are generated translations. Catalog has introductory manufacturing/history coverage and conceptual diagrams, not full 3D/anatomical models or an exhaustive encyclopedia.

preview.label: Current Curiosity Universe (verified export; not a historical snapshot)
